scripts.deploy:local: mvn -B -q package -DskipTests && pnpm run deploy:sample && pnpm run deploy:receipt
scripts.deploy:sample: cd sample-solution && AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=test AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=test AWS_REGION=us-east-1 sls deploy --stage local
scripts.deploy:receipt: cd receipt-solution && AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=test AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=test AWS_REGION=us-east-1 sls deploy --stage local
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run deploy:local && mvn -B verify -Pe2e -pl sample-solution/e2e,receipt-solution/e2e
